value.rationale: Backward Euler is a canonical positive stiff-decay integrator, and Richardson extrapolation is a canonical accuracy accelerator. The theorem gives a sharp structural incompatibility between those two features, including a closed threshold for the standard construction and an all-refinement law showing that positivity radius grows only logarithmically despite linearly increasing substep work.
